info.name: HagzNow Backend - Complete API
info.description:
# HagzNow Backend API

Import this Postman Collection v2.1 file into **Postman** or **Apidog**.

## Quick start
1. Set `baseUrl` if the API is not running at `http://localhost:3000`.
2. Edit the account variables, then run **Auth > Login as User**, **Login as Owner**, or **Login as Admin**. Each login stores its role token and also makes it the active `jwt`.
3. Requests use the appropriate role token automatically. IDs returned by common create/read requests are stored as collection variables.
4. The collection sends `X-Language` and a new `X-Correlation-ID` automatically.

## Authentication
Protected requests use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Registration and login return the token inside `data.token` because successful API responses use the standard envelope shown below. Owner registration creates a pending owner; complete owner verification and have an admin accept the request before using owner-only endpoints.

## Response envelope
JSON successes are expected as `{ "isSuccess": true, "message": "Success", "data": ..., "error": null }`. Errors are expected as `{ "isSuccess": false, "message": "...", "data": null, "error": { "code": "...", "details": ... } }`.

## Recommended workflow
Create a category, upload arena media, create an arena with courts/extras, approve the arena, discover slots, create a reservation, add an on-field transaction, then settle or cancel that pending transaction.

## Important source behavior
- `GET /arenas/detailed` currently accepts `categoryId` in a GET request body. Body pruning is disabled for that request, but some proxies may still discard GET bodies.
- `PATCH /arenas/:id/:status` requires the status path value and currently also reads `{ "status": ... }` from the body.
- `PATCH /reservations/:id` and `DELETE /reservations/:id` are currently service stubs and have no role decorator.
- `DELETE /arenas/:id` currently has no role decorator.
- The Paymob webhook is provider-facing; use an authentic provider payload and HMAC for meaningful testing.

Generated from the application controllers and DTOs on 2026-07-25.
